_comment: Product ids that appear in `integration.endpoint_moved` audit rows but no longer
have a `products` row, with the slug each one had. This file exists because an
audit row written before AECI-991 records only product IDS, and once the product
is deleted there is no query anywhere that recovers the slug it used to hold.
Every entry is an operator ruling and must be sourced. Do not add one from memory:
an id mapped to the wrong slug writes a redirect that sends readers to the wrong
page, and nothing downstream can tell.
Audit rows written from AECI-991 onward carry `before_state.productSlugs`, so they
need no entry here and this file should stop growing.

463d5f20-a73a-4776-b26a-fcdf3818accd.source: AECI-809 / AECI-991 — ACC merged into Autodesk Forma and the record was retracted 2026-09-16. The id is named in AECI-991's evidence table and the slug is the one `slug_redirects` maps (migration 0039_late_mysterio.sql).
